stories.title: Man accused of stabbing his father to death in Huron Township, prosecutors say
stories.summary: A man was charged in connection with the fatal stabbing of his father​ in Huron Township, according to the Wayne County Prosecutor's Office.

stories.title: Mexico arrests drug kingpin on FBI's 10 Most Wanted, sparking violence in Sinaloa
stories.summary: Fausto Isidro Meza-Flores is allegedly the leader of a cartel responsible for drug distribution and importation.

stories.title: Lock of George Washington's hair sold at auction for $4,000
stories.summary: South Carolina-based auction house Richmond Auctions said George Washington's lock of hair was sold for $4,000.

stories.title: Plymouth man accused of killing his mother in Gratiot County, MSP says
stories.summary: A Plymouth man who is the suspect in an investigation involving the homicide of his mother in Gratiot County has been arrested, Michigan State Police say.

stories.title: Gold Star families frustrated with Pentagon investigation into Iran drone strike that killed 6 soldiers
stories.summary: The Pentagon is preparing to release findings of its investigation into the attack that killed six U.S. soldiers in Kuwait early in the Iran war.

stories.title: How to watch: Light Up Beacon Park tree lighting in Detroit
stories.summary: CBS News Detroit is streaming live coverage of the event from 7-8 p.m. ET, with the tree lighting set for 7:30 p.m.

stories.title: Kate, Princess of Wales, announces she's in remission from cancer
stories.summary: Princess Kate made the announcement on social media after visiting the London hospital where she received treatment.

stories.title: Why the Army says it needs to detonate unstable, lead-filled explosives in Iowa and what's at risk
stories.summary: A federal court indefinitely suspended the U.S. Army's plans to detonate 68 drums of lead azide in Iowa after communities raised concerns.

stories.title: No. 14 Oregon routs Michigan State 45-7
stories.summary: Brandon Smith set career highs with 121 yards and two touchdowns, kicker Gage Hurych ran for a 15-yard scored on a fake field goal and No. 14 Oregon routed Michigan State 45-7 to hold onto hopes of earning a spot in the College Football Playoff.

stories.title: Scottie Barnes scores 29 as Raptors end skid with 105-102 win over Pistons
stories.summary: Scottie Barnes scored 29 points, including a crucial layup, as the Toronto Raptors snap their six-game losing streak with a 105-102 victory over the Detroit Pistons in an NBA Cup game.

stories.title: Child shot with unsecured gun on Detroit's west side, police say
stories.summary: Police are investigating after a 5-year-old was shot with an unsecured gun Friday on Detroit's west side.

stories.title: Thousands gather for annual Tree Lighting ceremony in Detroit
stories.summary: Thousands of people traveled to downtown Detroit for the annual Christmas Tree Lighting ceremony on Friday. While families enjoyed the event, law enforcement officials and community leaders worked to make sure people were safe.
